descripcion: Extract obtained from calendula flowers in a glycolic vehicle, traditionally associated with a softening and conditioning effect on the skin. It is incorporated into the aqueous phase of emulsions, gels, and bath products. A classic of natural cosmetics, in high demand for sensitive-skin formulations and baby products.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellow to amber tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydroglycolic extract of chamomile flowers, valued in formulations for delicate skin for its softening character. It is used in the aqueous phase of creams, toners, shampoos, and hair products associated with light-toned highlights. Its recognition among consumers makes it a botanical-origin selling point.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellow to amber tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Aloe vera leaf extract in a glycolic vehicle, associated with a moisturizing and refreshing effect on the skin. It incorporates easily into the aqueous phase of gels, emulsions, and hair products. Widely used in after-sun formulations, liquid soaps, and daily-care lines.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to slightly amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Green tea leaf extract in a glycolic vehicle, associated with an antioxidant profile due to its natural polyphenol content. It is used in facial, body, and hair formulations aimed at caring for skin exposed to environmental factors. It provides a well-recognized botanical positioning in anti-aging and urban-protection lines.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — amber to brown tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Extract of rosemary leaves, traditionally associated with scalp vitality and an antioxidant profile. In cosmetics it is used in hair tonics, shampoos, and lotions; in food, certain rosemary extracts are used as a natural antioxidant in accordance with applicable regulations. A versatile botanical with a strong tradition in the Latin American market.
aplicaciones: Food formulations in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — amber to greenish tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Centella asiatica extract in a glycolic vehicle, widely used in body and facial care formulations associated with the appearance of skin firmness. It is an emblematic ingredient of firming lines, cosmetic-use anti-cellulite products, and care for stressed skin. Compatible with the aqueous phase of emulsions and gels.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellow to brown tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Botanical witch hazel extract, valued in cosmetics for its astringent and toning character. It is used in facial toners, aftershave lotions, and products for oily-prone skin. Its long tradition of use makes it a well-recognized ingredient in skin-cleansing and balancing formulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to amber, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Oat kernel extract in a glycolic vehicle, traditionally associated with a softening and protective effect on the skin. It is a common ingredient in soaps, creams, and shampoos for delicate skin, as well as in pet hygiene products. It is incorporated into the aqueous phase of the formulation.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellow to light brown tone, varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Extract of cucumber fruit in a glycolic vehicle, associated with a refreshing, moisturizing sensation. Widely used in eye contour gels, masks, and facial toners in fresh, lightweight lines. It provides a natural positioning that is easy to communicate to consumers.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale greenish, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Concentrated juice obtained from the aloe vera leaf, designed to be reconstituted in the aqueous phase of the formulation. In cosmetics it is used in gels, lotions, and moisturizing hair products; in food and beverages, it is used in accordance with applicable regulations. It allows aloe to be dosed efficiently in industrial production.
funciones: Botanical base for the aqueous phase
formas_referenciales: Liquid — viscosity and tone varying depending on the manufacturer's concentration grade and batch

descripcion: Powder obtained by dehydrating the juice of the aloe vera leaf, intended for reconstitution in water during the production process. It simplifies storage and transport compared with fresh juice, with flexible dosing in cosmetics, food, and supplements in accordance with applicable regulations. Checking the reconstitution factor on the batch technical data sheet (TDS) is recommended.
aplicaciones: Beverages and food in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder; particle size and tone varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Vegetable oil obtained from coconut pulp, widely used as an emollient in soapmaking, creams, and hair products. Its fatty profile makes it a base raw material in saponification and in conditioning formulas. In food, it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid to liquid depending on ambient temperature — low melting point; appearance varying depending on the manufacturer, origin, and batch

descripcion: A classic vegetable oil in cosmetics, valued for its soft feel and good spreadability on the skin. It is the traditional base for massage oils and baby products, and a versatile emollient in emulsions. Compatible with most cosmetic oil phases.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — pale yellow to golden tone, varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: A liquid vegetable wax with a composition close to the skin's natural sebum, valued for its dry feel and high stability compared with other oils. It is used as an emollient in facial, hair, and barbering formulas. Its stability makes it well suited to products with demanding shelf-life requirements.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — yellow to golden tone, varying depending on the refining, origin, and batch

descripcion: Oil obtained from rosehip seeds, an emblem of South American cosmetics traditionally associated with caring for the appearance of the skin. Naturally rich in unsaturated fatty acids, it is used in serums, facial oils, and products for mature skin or skin with visible marks. A high-perceived-value ingredient in premium lines.
aplicaciones: Cosmetic products for the appearance of scars
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — orange to reddish tone, varying depending on the refining, origin, and batch

descripcion: Vegetable oil from avocado pulp, valued as a nourishing emollient in hair and body cosmetics. Colombia and the Andean region are a growing origin for this raw material, which supports nearby supply chains. In food, it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — green to yellow tone depending on the degree of refining, origin, and batch

descripcion: High-viscosity vegetable oil obtained from the castor seed, with a long tradition of use in hair products, lip products, and soapmaking. Its dense, glossy character makes it a common ingredient in makeup and in cosmetic-use formulas for brows and lashes. It also has technical applications as an oleochemical raw material.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — colorless to pale yellow, depending on the refining and batch

descripcion: Vegetable oil from sesame seeds, with good natural stability and a tradition of use in massage and body care. As an emollient it provides a nourished feel without being excessively heavy. In food, it is used in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — yellow to golden tone, varying depending on the roasting, refining, and batch

descripcion: Amazonian oil obtained from the sacha inchi seed, naturally rich in omega fatty acids. It is an ambassador of the biodiversity of Colombia and the Amazon, with growing demand in hair and facial cosmetics and in the nutraceutical sector in accordance with applicable regulations. It brings a sustainable-origin story that is highly valued in natural lines.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — yellow to golden tone, varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Vegetable oil from macadamia nuts, valued for its silky feel and rapid absorption into the skin. Its profile positions it in hair and facial formulas with a lightweight finish. Colombia has its own macadamia production, which favors regional sourcing.
formas_referenciales: Oily liquid — pale yellow to golden tone, depending on the refining and batch

descripcion: Vegetable butter obtained from the nut of the shea tree, a worldwide reference as a nourishing emollient in cosmetics. It provides body and a protective feel in creams, body butters and lip products, and is also used in edible fats, supplements and veterinary products in accordance with applicable regulations. Available in refined and unrefined grades, with characteristics confirmed in the batch technical data sheet.
aplicaciones: Edible fats and veterinary formulations in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — butter with an ivory to yellowish texture and tone, depending on the manufacturer and batch (varies with refining and origin)

descripcion: Vegetable butter obtained from cocoa seeds, one of Colombia's flagship crops. It provides consistency, gloss and a protective feel in lip products, body butters and soap making; it is also used as a fat base in confectionery, in solid or semisolid pharmaceutical and veterinary forms and in supplements, in accordance with applicable regulations. Its characteristic aroma and local origin make it a highlight of natural product lines.
aplicaciones: Confectionery and foods in accordance with regulations
Excipient in pharmaceutical and veterinary forms
formas_referenciales: Solid — blocks, pieces or pastilles depending on the manufacturer and batch; melts at body temperature

descripcion: Vegetable butter obtained from the mango seed, with a lighter feel than other traditional butters. It is used as an emollient and consistency agent in creams, conditioners, and balms with a non-greasy finish. An interesting alternative for formulations seeking a fresh sensory profile with nourishment.
formas_referenciales: Solid — ivory-toned butter, texture varying depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amazonian butter obtained from the seeds of cupuaçu, a botanical relative of cocoa, associated with a remarkable water-retention capacity. It is used as a moisturizing emollient in creams, hair treatments, and naturally positioned lip products. A star ingredient of cosmetics with an Amazonian identity and trade with local communities.
formas_referenciales: Solid — ivory to beige butter, texture varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Essential oil obtained from lavender flowers, one of the most versatile aromatic profiles in functional perfumery. It is used to scent soaps, candles, cosmetics, and household cleaning products, and is a staple of aromatherapy. Its dosage must follow the recommended use levels in the finished product.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale yellow, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Essential oil from eucalyptus leaves, with a fresh, penetrating aroma traditionally associated with a breathable sensation of freshness. It is a common fragrance ingredient in cleaning products, soaps, shower gels, and external-use preparations. Colombia has eucalyptus plantations that supply the regional industry.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale yellow, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Peppermint essential oil, recognized for its intense aroma and its sensory cooling effect. It is used in hair and bath cosmetics, oral hygiene, cleaning products, and as a flavoring in food in accordance with applicable regulations. A multifunctional classic of the aromatic portfolio.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale yellow, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Essential oil obtained by pressing sweet orange peel, with a naturally high limonene content. In addition to its use as a fragrance in cosmetics and a flavoring in food in accordance with applicable regulations, it is valued in citrus cleaners for its degreasing contribution. Citrus farming in the Andean region makes it a nearby-origin ingredient.
aplicaciones: Beverages and food in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — yellow to orange tone, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Citrus essential oil obtained from lemon peel, with a clean, bright aroma universally associated with cleanliness. It is used as a fragrance in household and institutional cleaning products and as a flavoring in food and beverages in accordance with applicable regulations. Its natural limonene content gives cleaners degreasing power.
aplicaciones: Beverages and food in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — pale yellow to greenish tone, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Essential oil from melaleuca leaves, traditionally associated with the care of blemish-prone skin and scalps with visible dandruff. It is incorporated into gels, shampoos, soaps, and pet hygiene products, always at the recommended use levels. One of the highest-turnover essential oils in functional cosmetics.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale yellow, aromatic profile varying depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: Floral water obtained during the distillation of rose petals, with a delicate aroma and a mild toning character. It can partially or fully replace the water in the formula in toners, mists, and light emulsions. It provides a romantic botanical positioning with a long tradition in facial care.
formas_referenciales: Aqueous liquid — colorless, aromatic intensity varying depending on the distillation, origin, and batch

descripcion: Powder obtained by grinding walnut shells, used as a natural-origin mechanical exfoliant in soaps, shower gels, and body scrubs. It is a natural-origin alternative to plastic microbeads, aligned with regulatory and market trends. It is also used in industrial-use degreasing soaps.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, particle size varying depending on the manufacturer and batch
